versions.content: At a send request of a signal with ComTransferProperty TRIG- GERED_ON_CHANGE_WITHOUT_REPETITION assigned to an I-PDU with ComTxModeMode DIRECT or MIXED, the AUTOSAR COM module shall immediate- ly (within the next main function at the latest) initiate one transmission of the as- signed I-PDU, if the new sent signal differs to the locally stored (last sent or init) in length or value.
